page.overview:
Who is Himuka Suzukaze?

After graduating from the Academy, she was added to Team 2 under the leadership of Yūki Minazuki. Her teammates were Yōji Aburame, a fellow graduate, and Itachi Uchiha, who graduated the year before her. Although he was much younger than her, Himuka called Itachi "master" because of how skilled he was. Itachi left the team only a few months after she joined, but Himuka continued to admire him throughout his career. Years later, she was saddened by Itachi's involvement in the Uchiha Clan Downfall.
